# Project rules

## Git

- **Never add `Co-authored-by`, `Signed-off-by`, "Generated by", or any AI/assistant attribution** to commits, PRs or code. The only author of this repository is `Mateusz Kata <prodevcodepl@gmail.com>` (GitHub: `mkatadev`). Do not use any other identity or e-mail.
- Do not commit `.idea/`, `local.properties`, `keystore.properties`, `release.keystore`, `build/` — they are gitignored on purpose and must stay so.
- Commit messages: short imperative subject with an optional scope prefix (`docs:`, `ci:`, `third-party.sh:`); no trailers, no boilerplate.
- Do not push, force-push, tag or rewrite history without being asked. Force-push only with `--force-with-lease`.

## Releases

- **Pushing a tag `vX.Y.Z` publishes a release** (`release.yml`). Never create or push tags unless explicitly asked to release a new version. Documentation and CI changes alone never warrant a release.
- `versionName` comes from the tag, `versionCode` is derived from it (`1.2.3 → 10203`). Do not hardcode versions in Gradle files.

## Third-party code

- `airplay-core/src/main/cpp/third_party/*` are git submodules pinned to exact upstream commits. Never edit files inside submodules.
- Local changes to UxPlay go to `airplay-core/src/main/cpp/patches/UxPlay/*.patch` and are applied at CMake configure time.
- Bump components only via `tools/third-party.sh update <component> <ref>`; commit the submodule pointer together with `third_party/VERSIONS.md`. CI rejects stale `VERSIONS.md` and patches that do not apply.

## Documentation

- `README.md` (EN) and `README.pl.md` (PL) must stay in sync — every change goes to both.
- Keep README facts consistent with the code (SDK/NDK versions, Gradle tasks, workflow names, script options).
- Do not create extra markdown files (plans, notes, summaries) unless asked.

## Code

- Minimal, surgical changes; do not touch unrelated code or "fix" unrelated issues.
- `:app` layering: `domain/` has no Android/Hilt dependencies beyond `javax.inject`; `data/` implements repositories; `presentation/` is Compose for TV; `di/` holds Hilt bindings.
- Verify with the smallest relevant command: `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest`, `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug`.
- Comment code only where clarification is genuinely needed.
